## Purpose

Describe the player or engineering outcome and the evidence that motivates it.

## Scope

- What changed:
- What deliberately did not change:
- Roadmap or issue link:

## Validation

- [ ] Python format and lint plus native source-policy gates pass.
- [ ] Python tests pass with at least 80 percent meaningful coverage.
- [ ] CI and runtime dependency locks are current and audit clean.
- [ ] Native build, format, tests, and coverage pass when native code changes.
- [ ] Documentation links and content inventory pass when relevant.
- [ ] New assets have explicit origin, license, checksum, and pack status.
- [ ] No secrets, private paths, generated caches, or unrelated changes are included.

## Player evidence

Record the fixed seed, ruleset, accessibility profile, replay, screenshot, or
observation evidence used to evaluate the change. State any evidence still missing.
